0022600018.text: The New York Knicks (2-3) visit the Philadelphia 76ers (4-1) in an Emirates NBA Cup East Group B game, the sixth of the season for New York, which sits fourth in the Atlantic and eighth in the East, two games back in its division. The teams split 2-2 in 2025-26 and New York won the 2025-26 playoff series 4-0, but the Knicks trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after losing 106-100 in New York on October 20. New York is without Jose Alvarado (ankle sprain), and Karl-Anthony Towns is day-to-day with a wrist sprain and a game-time decision, while Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back fracture), Jabari Walker (knee soreness) and Tacko Fall (quadriceps strain), with Jaylen Brown day-to-day with a knee injury and a game-time decision.
